brand.name: Creative Nepal
brand.webDescription: Point of sale, IRD-ready invoicing and stock control for marts, pharmacies and restaurants.

error.serverBodyWeb: This page hit an unexpected error. Try again — if it keeps happening, send the reference below to support.
error.serverBodyAdmin: The dashboard hit an unexpected error. Try again — if it keeps happening, send the reference below to engineering.
error.appCrashedBody: Something broke outside the page itself. Reloading usually clears it.
error.notFoundBodyWeb: This page does not exist, or it moved. Check the address, or start again from the home page.
error.notFoundBodyAdmin: This page does not exist, or it moved. Start again from the overview.
error.notFoundBodyMarketing: This page does not exist, or it has not been published yet.
error.recordNotFoundBody: This business, plan or user does not exist any more. It may have been deleted.
error.workspaceNotFoundBody: That record does not exist, or it belongs to a different business. Switch business, or pick a screen from the sidebar.
error.screenFailedBody: The rest of your workspace is fine. Retry the screen, or pick another one from the sidebar.
error.viewFailedBody: The rest of the dashboard is fine. Retry the view, or pick another one from the sidebar.
error.dataFailedBody: The request failed. Retry it, or move to another screen and come back.
error.authUnavailableBody: We could not reach the authentication service. Try again in a moment.

auth.signInSubtitleAdmin: Sign in to the admin dashboard.
auth.forgotPasswordSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
auth.resetLinkInvalid: This reset link is missing or invalid.
auth.googleSignInFailed: Unable to sign in with Google
auth.resetTokenMissing: Reset link is missing or invalid.

overview.title: Overview
overview.emptyBody: Businesses appear here as accounts create them.
overview.bySectorHint: Each sector is an independent subscription surface.

businesses.title: Businesses
businesses.description: Every business across every account. Suspend or close a business independently of its own owner.
businesses.cbmsQueued: Invoices are being queued for CBMS
businesses.auditEmptyBody: Audit entries appear here as this business issues, prints, and credits invoices.
businesses.noSubscription: No active subscription. This business has no plan entitlements.
businesses.subscriptionEnding: Subscription will end at the current period end
businesses.branchesDescription: Each branch keeps its own gapless invoice series and its own stock.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: The global plan catalog. Feature flags here drive entitlements and seat limits.
plans.keyHint: Lowercase slug, unique within the sector.
plans.priceHint: In major units; stored as integer minor units.
plans.maxStaffHint: Enforced by Better Auth's own membership limit.

billing.title: Platform billing
billing.description: What businesses owe this platform — distinct from the invoices they issue their own customers.
billing.emptyBody: Invoices appear once the billing run charges an active subscription.

users.title: Users
users.description: Manage user accounts, roles, sessions and access.
users.noAccessBody: This session cannot list users. Stop impersonating, or sign in with a platform admin account.
users.detailsHint: Read straight from the server, so it reflects changes made elsewhere.
users.sessionsEmptyBody: This user is not signed in anywhere.

content.title: Content
content.description: Every public page on the marketing site. Published changes reach visitors within a minute.
content.deleteBody: /{slug} disappears from the public site immediately, along with every translation.
content.slugChangeHint: Changing this changes the public URL; old links stop working.
content.newPageHint: The page starts as a draft with no blocks. Add content, then publish it to put it on the public site.
content.pageDetailsHint: Title and search-engine metadata for this locale.
content.seoTitleHint: Falls back to the page title.
content.noIndexHint: Sends noindex — use for legal or thank-you pages.
content.blocksHint: Rendered top to bottom on the public page.
content.blocksEmptyBody: Add a hero to open the page, then stack features, FAQs or a closing call to action.
content.heading: Heading
content.question: Question
content.imageUrlHint: Optional. A site path or a full https URL.
content.markdownHint: Headings, lists, links and emphasis. Raw HTML is not rendered.

blockHint.hero: Headline with up to two buttons
blockHint.pricing: Live plan cards, priced from the plans catalogue.

content.navigationDescription: Header links and footer groups for the public site, per language.
content.headerLinksHint: Shown in the public site header, in this order.
content.footerGroupsHint: Each group becomes a column in the site footer.

notifications.title: Alerts
notifications.cbmsFailedBody: {count} invoice(s) failed to reach the IRD
notifications.jobFailedBody: {count} run(s) failed in the last day

site.previewBanner: Draft preview — this page is not live.

workspace.noBusinessBody: Create a business to start selling. Your account can hold several — a mart, a pharmacy and a restaurant each bill independently.

pos.title: Point of sale
pos.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or SKU, or scan a barcode...
pos.cartEmpty: Add items to start a sale.
pos.panRequired: Buyer name and PAN are required above NPR 10,000.
pos.prescriptionHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 10 MB
pos.noSubstitutes: No other brand of this generic is on the catalogue.
pos.noGenericName: This product has no generic name recorded, so alternatives cannot be matched.
pos.promisedHint: For an advance order — leave blank for right now.
pos.noProductsHint: Try a different name, SKU or barcode.

products.title: Products
products.emptyBody: Products added here become sellable at the point of sale.
products.descriptionBatch: Stock is tracked per batch; the figure here is the live, unexpired total.
products.unitsPerPackHint: How many sellable units are in one pack — 10 tablets in a strip. 1 means the pack is the unit.
products.subUnitLabelHint: What one unit is called on the bill: tab, cap, ml.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Every number ever issued, including voided and credited ones — invoices are never deleted.
invoices.fiscalYearPlaceholder: Fiscal year, e.g. 2083-84 (required for the register export)
invoices.emptyBody: Invoices appear here as sales are completed.

batches.title: Batches
batches.description: Stock nearing expiry. An expired batch is automatically unsellable — it cannot be dispensed even if selected.
batches.recallHint: Everyone who bought from this batch, and what is left on the shelf.
batches.quarantineConfirm: Write off the {remaining} left on the shelf and stop this batch being dispensed? This cannot be undone.
batches.noDispenses: Nothing from this batch has been dispensed.

purchasing.title: Purchasing
purchasing.description: Suppliers, orders, goods receipt and bills. Stock enters the system here.
purchasing.ordersEmptyBody: Create an order against a supplier, then record the goods when they arrive.
purchasing.billsEmptyBody: A supplier's bill can arrive before, with, or after the goods.
purchasing.receiveHint: Stock enters here, and cost is recomputed as a weighted average against what is already on hand.
purchasing.debitNotesEmptyBody: A debit note records goods returned to a supplier, or a rate correction against their bill.
purchasing.debitNoteHint: Issued against this bill. The amount is capped at the bill total, and issuing one never recomputes the weighted-average cost.
purchasing.restockHint: Removes the returned quantity from stock and writes a ledger entry. Every line needs a product.

restaurant.kitchenDescription: Tickets are grouped by station. Refreshes every few seconds.
restaurant.kitchenEmptyBody: Confirmed orders appear here as tickets.
restaurant.menuDescription: Turning an item off hides it from the QR menu immediately and blocks it at checkout.
restaurant.tablesDescription: Billing covers the whole sitting — every order placed against the table.
restaurant.tableFreed: Table freed for the next sitting
restaurant.areasDescription: Group tables by floor, room or section. Areas are per branch.
restaurant.areaExists: An area with that name already exists in this branch
restaurant.areaInUse: Move the tables out of the area before deleting it
restaurant.noAreasHint: Tables without an area still work — areas only group them on this screen.
restaurant.billDescription: Split the sitting between the people paying.
restaurant.moveDescription: Open orders move with the kitchen tickets, so the food follows the guests.

split.itemsHint: One invoice for the whole sitting.
split.equalHint: Each person gets an equal share of the bill.

move.transferHint: This table is emptied and its QR session revoked.
move.mergeHint: Every chosen table is emptied and billed together here.
move.nothingToMerge: No other table has open orders.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Business details, plan, and what this account owes for the platform.
settings.businessDetailsHint: The legal name and PAN printed on every invoice.
settings.ownerOnly: Only an owner can change business details
settings.noPlan: No active plan. Ask the operator to assign one.
settings.brandingDescription: How this business appears to your staff. Colours are validated before they are stored.
settings.billingRulesHint: How service charge and discounts are applied to every sale.
settings.serviceChargePercentHint: Added to the discounted subtotal before VAT. 0 switches it off.
settings.maxDiscountPercentHint: The largest discount staff may apply to a sale. 0 switches discounts off.
settings.orgSettingsHint: Contact details, receipts and which alerts you want.
settings.invoiceFooterHint: Printed at the bottom of every receipt.
settings.branchRoleHint: Overrides the organisation role for this branch only.
settings.referralHint: Paid once, on the referred customer’s first purchase.

staff.title: Staff
staff.description: Roles are enforced by the API on every action, not just hidden in this interface.

roleHelp.manager: Products, orders, invoices — not business settings
roleHelp.cashier: Take orders and issue invoices only
roleHelp.pharmacist: The only role that may dispense prescription or controlled items
roleHelp.waiter: Confirm and serve orders, manage tables
roleHelp.chef: Kitchen tickets only — never sees pricing or billing
roleHelp.receptionist: Book appointments, sell services, manage memberships
roleHelp.practitioner: Complete their own appointments; no billing

staff.removeBody: {email} will lose access to this business immediately.
staff.assignHint: Leave every branch unticked to allow all of them. Ticking any restricts them to those.

services.title: Services
services.description: What this business offers, and the session packages customers hold.
services.emptyBody: Add what this business offers, with a price and how long it takes.
services.membershipsEmptyBody: A membership pre-pays a number of sessions; each completed appointment spends one.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.description: Today and ahead. Completing one spends a membership session if the booking used a membership.
appointments.emptyBody: Bookings appear here once reception schedules them.
appointments.noHours: No hours set — this person can be booked any time

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Each branch keeps its own gapless invoice series and its own stock.
branches.newHint: The code prefixes this branch’s invoice numbers and cannot change once invoices exist.
branches.codeHint: Uppercase letters and digits, up to 8 characters.
branches.emptyBody: Every business starts with one branch; open another when you trade from a second location.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.shortfallBody: {items} went negative when an order was confirmed

menu.recipeHint: What one serving consumes. Confirming an order to the kitchen depletes these from branch stock.
menu.noRecipe: No recipe — this item depletes nothing

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Who buys on account, and what they owe.
customers.emptyBody: Add a customer to sell on account and track what they owe.
customers.referralShare: Share this code — the customer earns points when a friend makes their first purchase.
customers.referralClaimHint: Only before this customer makes their first purchase.
customers.referralOff: Referral rewards are switched off. Set them in Settings.

stockTakes.title: Stock takes
stockTakes.description: Count what is physically on the shelf and reconcile it against the system.
stockTakes.openHint: This snapshots every product's current quantity on this branch. Sales made while you count are preserved.
stockTakes.emptyHint: Start one to reconcile shelf quantities against the system.
stockTakes.cancelConfirm: Cancel this stock take? Nothing will be applied to stock.
stockTakes.completeConfirm: Apply {count} variance line(s) to stock? This cannot be undone.

reservations.title: Reservations
reservations.emptyHint: Bookings taken for this branch will show up here.
reservations.noShowConfirm: Mark this booking as a no show?

cash.title: Till
cash.description: Open the drawer, take payments, and reconcile at day end.
cash.openingFloatHint: The cash already in the drawer before trading starts.
cash.noSessionHint: Open it with the starting float to begin taking cash.
cash.closeHint: Count the drawer and enter the total. The variance against {expected} is recorded.

channels.title: Delivery channels
channels.description: Aggregators you sell through, and what each one costs you.
channels.name: Channel
channels.emptyHint: Add Foodmandu, Bhoj or Pathao Food with the commission each charges.

wastage.title: Wastage
wastage.description: What was thrown away, and what it cost.
wastage.emptyHint: Log spoilage and spillage here so food cost stays visible.
wastage.recipeNote: A dish deducts its recipe ingredients from stock.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.description: Running costs, and how they were paid.
expenses.emptyHint: Rent, gas, repairs and anything else that is not stock.
expenses.tillNote: A cash expense while the till is open is deducted from the drawer.

loyalty.loyaltyHint: Points earned on every billed sale to a known customer. Zero switches it off.

data.importHint: CSV or Excel. The first row must be the column headers.
data.templateHint: Export first to get a file with the right columns.
data.stockNote: Stock is only set on new items; existing stock is left alone.
data.balanceNote: Balances are not imported; they come from the ledger.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.scopeHint: An organisation entry is visible to everyone; a branch entry only at that branch; a personal one only to you.
calendar.emptyHint: Add a reminder, a deadline or a closure day.
calendar.noPanchang: Tithi and festival names are not included; mark your own closures as a holiday entry.

reports.liveSalesDescription: The day's takings for this branch, in the business timezone.
reports.uncosted: {count} line(s) have no recorded cost, so their profit reads high
reports.noSalesHint: Sell something in this period and it will appear here.
reports.profitDescription: What each item earned after the cost it was bought or made for.
reports.receivablesDescription: Money customers owe you, aged from the date of each credit sale.
reports.payablesDescription: Money you owe suppliers, aged from each bill’s due date.
reports.stockMovementDescription: Every movement in and out of stock for one item.
reports.receivablesHint: A payment clears the oldest debt first.
reports.payablesHint: A bill with no due date is aged from its bill date.
reports.agingEmptyHint: Credit sales and unpaid supplier bills show up here.
reports.stockMovementHint: Pick an item to see every purchase, sale, wastage and adjustment against it.
reports.liveDescription: The day's takings for this branch, in the business timezone.

production.title: Production
production.description: Plan what gets made each day and record what actually came out.
production.emptyBody: Plan a run and it will show here with what still has to be made.
production.doneAddsStock: Marking a run done adds what was produced to stock.

hotel.frontDeskDescription: Bookings from arrival to check-out, with everything charged to the room.
hotel.roomsDescription: Rooms and their types, rates and occupancy.
hotel.housekeepingDescription: What needs cleaning, who is on it, and which rooms are ready to sell.
hotel.noRoomsHint: Add a room type first, then the rooms that belong to it.
hotel.noBookingsHint: Take a booking and it will appear here.
hotel.noTasksHint: A task appears here when a guest checks out.
hotel.checkedIn: Checked in — the room is now occupied
